SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, title, summary, cover_image AS coverImage, CAST(author_id AS CHAR) AS authorId, views, likes, favorites, comments, publish_time AS publishTime FROM t_article WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 3
AND author_id IN
#{aid}
ORDER BY (CAST(#{wViews} AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) * views + CAST(#{wLikes} AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) * likes + CAST(#{wFav} AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) * favorites + CAST(#{wComm} AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) * comments) DESC
ORDER BY publish_time DESC
